sources.title: Fake OpenAI AI Model Becomes No 1 Trending Repo With 244,000 Downloads ...
sources.snippet: Fake AI projects are becoming the latest trap for developers hunting for new tools online. A malicious repository posing as an OpenAI model climbed to the top of Hugging Face's trending page, pulling in roughly 244,000 downloads before researchers exposed it as malware designed to steal browser data, crypto wallets, developer credentials, and Discord accounts from Windows machines.
